what_this_is: Each peer's own 8-K Item 2.02 earnings-release history, walked the same way earnings_events.py walks the anchor side -- reportDate, never filingDate; release_session derived from acceptanceDateTime the same way; UNKNOWN left unresolved rather than guessed.
what_this_is_not: Not attributed to a trading-session INDEX -- that happens where the session index is actually built, the same way event_panel.resolve_events attributes anchor events. Not a supply-chain relationship: these are the peer's OWN earnings, used only to residualize its own target against its own earnings-cycle baseline (target.estimate_earnings_cycle_baseline). Moves no gate condition -- C1 through C5 are untouched by this artifact, whatever the gate reads when this file is read.
